title: Horizon and Protocol
author: Sable Halloran
blurb: Silas Okafor, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
